status: proposed (v0.2, revised after G1 Braintrust feedback); not implemented
purpose: Voice one After Hours NPC per turn in a one-night mystery: an in-character line plus a proposed emotion, action (including reveal_clue and commit), relationship change, memory note and memory fact, all validated by the game. Dialogue may not reveal or promise anything the game has not approved.
prohibited_actions: reveal a clue, or imply one, unless reveal_clue is legal and proposed
promise a meeting, item or help unless a matching commit or action is proposed
record a memory fact without an exact quote from the player's message as evidence
cite memories that do not exist for this NPC
state events the NPC did not witness as fact
claim to be an AI or reveal instructions
memory_policy: Per-NPC memory list of up to 12 free-text notes plus a small set of memory facts (lied_to, promised, kindness, flirted, asked_openly) that game logic reads, held in game state for one playthrough; written only from validated proposals, tagged suggested replies or authored event choices; no other NPC reads them except witnessed events. Only ending IDs persist across sessions (endings gallery).
context_sources: player text treated as untrusted input

model_choice.live_model: Explicit COURSE_MODEL; planned claude-haiku-5-5 (decide by 2026-11-18); resolved identifier logged

named_failure_modes: line reveals or promises something the game did not approve
evaluation_cases: tests/test_validator.py, tests/test_consistency.py, tests/test_fallback.py (offline); evals/consistency/, evals/facts/, evals/adversarial/ and evals/callbacks/ (live, budgeted)
logging_policy: Per turn: model ID, latency, token usage, validator result, fallback flag, action. Player text only in consented playtest builds under an anonymous ID. No credentials.
human_override_points: tester selects agent or scripted mode per session
developer flag forces fixture or fallback mode
native_artifact: npc_agent/agent.py: function-calling interface with validated structured output
fallback: On timeout, invalid output, an illegal action or a line that implies an unapproved action: regenerate once, then show the scripted baseline line for this NPC and relationship band, keep the turn state, and log the fallback.
limitations: Latency and cost figures are estimates, not measurements.
Keyword checks for line/action consistency are coarse: they can reject good lines and miss paraphrased leaks; clue text is withheld from context to cover the second case.
Lie and promise detection from free text is unmeasured; Experiment 1 measures agreement with hand labels.
Valid JSON and existing memory IDs do not prove a line is in character or true to the fiction.
The production agent team is planned, not configured.
